revision_candidate.test_name: Validate GDS and Compare a Matched Non-GDS Path
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the exact 60-second GDS read from an approved 1 GiB mounted file to the mapped GPU and compare against an otherwise identical approved CPU-mediated path.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned NVIDIA CUDA/GDS/gdsio stack, supported filesystem/NVMe topology and mapped GPU UUID/BDF.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One disposable/pre-created mounted file, never raw storage; one GPU resolved from UUID/BDF to current tool index; paired 1-worker, 1-GiB, 1-MiB, read, 60-second runs.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Safe path/ownership/checksum, topology/support, GPU mapping, CPU xfer type, order/cache/warm-up/repetition/tolerance policy and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Inventory first; do not use source dd. Run `-x 0 -I 0 -w 1 -s 1G -i 1M -T 60` on approved file/GPU, then the documented CPU path with every other parameter equal.
revision_candidate.preconditions: No production data overlap; compatible stack; stable mapping; health/recovery ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: File/mount/device identity; GPU UUID/BDF/index/topology; versions/config; exact paired commands/results/errors; comparison calculation; storage/GPU/kernel/AER health and cleanup.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Exact GDS run is error-free and satisfies the owner-defined advantage/tolerance over its matched control; one unpaired score is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No raw/ambiguous path, stale index, dd, guessed CPU mode, workload mismatch, unapproved cache manipulation or universal superiority claim.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage and GDS owners approve file/topology/comparison.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent can run approved pair; engineering judges topology and performance.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop, preserve output, leave uncertain storage untouched and verify file/storage/GPU health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Path/map/method ambiguity, unsupported topology, checksum change, I/O/cuFile/GPU/AER error, timeout or incomplete pair.
